edges.reason: Constructor parameter impl feeds the initialization of the implementation slot.
newImpl parameter is encoded and written by setImplementation.
newAdmin parameter is encoded and written by setAdmin.
key parameter selects the storage slot read by _getAddress.
slot_ parameter is the slot read by the assembly sload in _getSlotValue.
value_ is the value produced by the sload in _getSlotValue.
slot_ parameter selects the destination slot of the assembly sstore.
value_ parameter is the raw value written by the assembly sstore.
implementation__ parameter is the target address passed to delegatecall.
result holds the delegatecall return status used by the switch.
add is the decoded address returned by _getAddress.
msg.sender becomes the initial admin written into ADMIN_SLOT.
setImplementation gates on msg.sender == admin before writing storage.
setAdmin gates on msg.sender == admin before writing storage.
Constructor calls _setSlotValue to initialize storage slots.
setImplementation calls _setSlotValue for the implementation slot.
setAdmin calls _setSlotValue for the admin slot.
_setSlotValue performs the raw sstore unsafe operation.
setImplementation calls _getAddress to read the admin slot.
setAdmin calls _getAddress to read the admin slot.
_getAddress reads the raw slot value via _getSlotValue.
implementation() reads the implementation slot via _getSlotValue.
fallback resolves the implementation address via _getAddress.
fallback forwards the call to _delegate.
_delegate executes an unchecked delegatecall to attacker-influenced implementation code.
fallback triggers a delegatecall that external code can exploit to re-enter the proxy.
The delegatecalled implementation can call back into the proxy fallback during execution.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant is the slot written by _setSlotValue.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant is the slot read by _getSlotValue.
ADMIN_SLOT constant is the slot written by _setSlotValue.
ADMIN_SLOT constant is the slot read for the admin address.
receive() accepts ether and never delegates, unlike fallback.
